_note: Measured additions for research/gladius-v1-fixture.json, 2026-10-08. Gladius, decoupled, Arena Commander, game 4.x LIVE. Recorded by AdobeWan with tools/sc-flighttest (CC BY 4.0). samples = [t seconds after the inputs start, HUD speed m/s], every 0.25 s; gaps are frames where the HUD could not be read (camera switch or blackout). See docs/HANDOFF-REPLY.md.

boost.G.down.source: speed slope 30-190 m/s: r4_boost_down 6.79, r11_boost_down_long 6.77 (G meter 6.7); r4's plateau is invalid

boost.tankDrain_pct_per_s.source: r7_tank_cycle: 100 -> 0 % in 20.2 s (5.00 %/s), re-drain from 25 % 4.99; ~40 other boosted tests 4.95-5.02

boost.tankRegen_pct_per_s.source: r7_tank_cycle (3.73-3.75 both after the tank emptied with boost still held and after release)

boost.redZonePct.source: r7_tank_cycle: with boost held through empty, boost re-engaged when the tank refilled to ~25 % and drained again

wall.releaseFloorG.source: r6_release_all/fwd_held/450/350 and r7_spacebrake_nose: 4.26-4.27 G between 300 and 235 m/s

boost.eggShape.source: settle speeds at 90 deg below/above/side, 120, ~137, 150, 180 (r10/r11 turns) plus round 3's 8.6/16.9/24.5 deg

rotation.combination.value: stick vector scaled to unit length (within ~3 %)

forwardAxis.value: the game's 'Throttle - Forward / Back': while deflected, thrust proportional to deflection (25 % -> 3.4 G, 50 % -> 6.9 G, then to the 225 cap); the game keeps a throttle setting after the axis returns to centre (seen after spacebraking: the ship sped back up to ~105 m/s after a 50 % test)

invalid.r4_boost_down.plateau: the harness let go at red-out (old 'release' policy) after 2.8 s; the 76 m/s 'plateau' is not a measurement

released_at_440.note: boost released at 440 m/s (summary.csv rel_start_mps mis-sampled); peaked 457 before the bleed

released_at_338.note: boost released at 338 m/s; peaked 367 before the bleed

turn180_boosted.note: did not settle before boost ended (still ~285 and falling); do not use as the 180 deg radius
